verdict.rationale: Termius says hosts, ports and passwords are saved so you "connect instantly" without re-entering them, and Keychain credentials can be referenced by many hosts. Saved hosts also sync across devices, so saved credentials follow the user. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs describing the literal one-tap/one-click connect flow, independent hands-on corroboration of connecting with saved credentials.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to a saved host with one tap without re-entering credentials

citations.quote: No more re-entering IPs, ports, or password. Everything is saved, so you connect instantly.
Items in the Keychain can be referenced by multiple Hosts and Groups without duplicating them.
Log in to your account — your Vaults, hosts, and configurations will be synced automatically.
